name: BSP_DecalDefinition_Ctor
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __fastcall(ECX = 0x28 record allocated at 00740878), sole caller 00740840. Zeroes the name string at +0x00/+0x04 and +0x14/+0x18/+0x1c, then loads the vertex format 'decal.mvfm' through renderer 00f8d394 vtable +0x34 into +0x14, the same object for every decal record. The remaining fields are filled by the caller from the Lua table. Evidence: docs/APP_INIT_WORLD_EFFECTS.md; reports/app_init_world_effects.json.

name: BSP_DecalSystem_LoadDefinitions
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Direct callee of BSP_Application_Initialize (0073d410); analysis-only packet app_initialize_map, no reconstruction. Called at 0073de8c. References scripts/datatables/decals.lua and the per-decal keys Radius, Texture, Shader, Decals, FadeOutTime, LifeTime and Maxnum. Evidence: docs/APP_INITIALIZE_MAP.md; reports/app_initialize_map.json. | Packet app_init_world_effects: __thiscall(ECX = 0x1c object allocated at 0073de6d), RET, EAX = this. Base ctor 0073fa70 publishes it at 00e1aea0. Loads scripts/datatables/decals.lua (length 0x1d), pushes the global 'Decals' and iterates it; each table-valued element allocates a 0x28 record built by 00740410. Layout: +0x00/+0x04 name, +0x08 Maxnum int (00b66290), +0x0c Size float (key 00cff278), +0x10 Radius float, +0x14 decal.mvfm format from the ctor, +0x18 Texture via renderer vtable +0x64, +0x1c Shader via vtable +0x48, +0x20 LifeTime float, +0x24 FadeOutTime float. Appended to a doubling vector at base+0x10, count+0x14, capacity+0x18, growth 0073e9a0 with max(1, cap*2). Installed file defines exactly three entries with all seven keys. See docs/APP_INIT_WORLD_EFFECTS.md.

name: BSP_DecalManager_Update
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_on_move_map, read-only analysis. Contains the literal profiler string cDecalManager::Update. Sole caller BSP_Game_OnMove at 004e533a, inside the state-0x0D simulation block, receiving the scaled frame delta from game+0x21F0. | Packet game_world_entities, read-only analysis. __thiscall(this, float), RET 4 (00740ea7); ECX is DAT_00e1aea0, which the map at docs/GAME_ON_MOVE_MAP.md left unrecorded. The delta argument is never read. After the one-shot label registration behind bit 0 of 00e1aeb0 the body walks a plain array (begin at this+4h, count at this+8h, stride 4) whose loop body is empty in the shipped image: 00740e91-00740e96 is ADD EAX,4 / CMP / JNZ and nothing else, so the per-decal work was compiled out and only the profiler label remains observable. docs/GAME_WORLD_ENTITIES.md.

name: BSP_VehicleClass_ConstructBase
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. docs/VEHICLE_CLASS_DESCRIPTORS.md. Base vehicle-class descriptor constructor, 0138h bytes. __fastcall(void* this) returning this, SEH handler 00C874BB. Calls 0087C640, writes the vptr pair 00CFF7CC primary / 00CFF7C8 at +6Ch, then zeroes dwords 1Dh, 1Eh, 20h, 25h-27h, 2Dh, 37h-47h, 4Ah-4Ch and the byte at 48h. The highest index it touches is 4Ch (+130h), which is why the smallest shipped descriptor (Shipyard) is exactly 0138h. All 22 kinds reach it, directly or through 00963380, 007D1E50 or 00749180.
